vibe_rationale: Club-run single-fin longboard contest, billed as the longest-running of its kind in Australia, with real heritage but a narrow single-scene format.
fit_notes: Adult log community with divisions into the over-80s and a regular New Zealand contingent; many local partners and a named sponsorship coordinator. No attendance is published, so reach is modest, but as a local Byron event an Australian brand can join directly as a partner.
